text: As the Patriots prepare to host the Steelers in their Sunday, September 20 home opener at Gillette Stadium (1 PM ET), the roster is undergoing some notable shuffling heading into what figures to be a challenging week—wide receiver A.J. Brown's high ankle sprain has landed him on injured reserve for at least four games, forcing Mike Reiss to examine who steps up in his absence during training, while the defensive line additions include free agent DaQuan Jones signing a one-year deal worth up to $6 million. The practice squad has seen its own churn, with Elliott Davison initially re-signed only to be released days later, along with running back Hassan Haskins, while the team brought in first-year wide receiver Chandler Brayboy and rookie linebacker Xavier Holmes to bolster depth. Off the field, owner Robert Kraft made news this week by explaining his decision to have Macklemore removed as an opening act for Ed Sheeran's concerts at Gillette Stadium, citing what he characterized as "a history of antisemitic rhetoric and imagery that we believe has been deeply offensive and hurtful to the Jewish community."
